steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Sign Up on Nakamoto Games Head to the Nakamoto Games website and register your account.
2 Step 2 : Discover the Game Library Check out a wide selection of play-to-earn and free-to-play games on the platform.
3 Step 3 : Complete Naka Quest for Rewards Join Naka Quest to earn rewards and level up your gaming experience.
4 Step 4 : Enter the Nakaverse Dive into the Nakaverse , a decentralized metaverse for building and exploring virtual cities.
5 Step 5 : Invite Friends and Earn Refer friends to join, and receive a 3% referral bonus each time they play a game.
